content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Bhopal Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 02-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhopal (AIIMS Bhopal) for project-based research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Project Research Scientist-II (PRS II) and Technician, offering exciting opportunities for qualified professionals in the research field.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced across different posts under this recruitment notification by AIIMS Bhopal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 02-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission to avoid any issues.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly via email. Candidates need to send their filled application form and documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for AIIMS Bhopal recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the candidates applying to these posts is below 35 years, with age relaxations provided for eligible categories like SC/ST as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary for the Project Research Scientist-II post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Research Scientist-II (PRS II) post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs 67,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. What educational qualification is required for the Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Technician post must have a three-year graduate degree in a relevant subject/field or BMLT along with research experience, or a relevant postgraduate degree.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates applying to any of the categories under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I visit to check the official updates and website?
faq.answer: You can visit the official AIIMS Bhopal website at http://aiimsbhopal.edu.in to access job notifications, download application forms, and view other announcements.
